text:
jess: Quick postmortem follow-up — token-count overreporting on 2024-03-28 caused two customer invoices to be ~12% higher. Need owners + timelines for reconciliation, invoice reissue, and customer comms.

omar: I'll own token reconciliation and generate the adjustments CSV. I'll run the verify query now and share results.

tara: I'll own invoice redraft + customer outreach templates. Need per-customer delta by EOD so CS can approve.

michael: I'll take the ingestion side RCA — I suspect a consumer lag causing duplicate ingest between 03:26–03:47 UTC. Adding dashboards and alerting now.

billing-bot: Manual adjustment ticket created: <https://jira.redwood/BZ-3421|BZ-3421> — queued for processing.

jess: Action items (owners/dates):
- Token reconciliation: Omar — run query + produce adjustments CSV (due Tue 09:00 PT).
- Invoice reissue draft: Tara — prepare updated invoices + legal check (due Thu EOD).
- Run manual adjustments: Billing team via BZ-3421 (finance-bot tracking).
- RCA timeline & deploy notes: Michael — update postmortem with timeline & patch info (due Wed noon).

omar: Starting query. Preview SQL I used:
```
SELECT customer_id, usage_date, SUM(raw_tokens) AS raw, SUM(recorded_tokens) AS recorded, 
       SUM(recorded_tokens) - SUM(raw_tokens) AS delta
FROM billing.usage_events
WHERE ingest_time BETWEEN '2024-03-28T03:20:00Z' AND '2024-03-28T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id, usage_date;
```

omar: Quick update — initial run shows ~1.2M tokens double-counted for acct 5321 and ~300k for acct 9872. Preparing adjustments CSV now (sample row: 5321,2024-03-28, -1200000)

tara: That sample helps. I'll draft a customer-facing note that explains the correction, the credit, and when they'll see the updated invoice.

offline note: CCing @michael for any wording about the root cause.

michael: Deployed a consumer fix to canary at 2024-04-01T15:42Z. The fix removes a duplicate-write path when retry_count > 0. I also created a dashboard: <https://dash.redwood/ingest/consumer-lag?range=7d>

michael: Added alert: ingest.consumer-lag > 5000ms for 5m, severity P2.

finance-bot: Invoice reissue pipeline kicked for BZ-3421. Estimated process time: ~48h. Link: <https://billing.redwood/adjustments/BZ-3421>

jess: Please update the postmortem doc with direct links to artifacts: adjustments CSV, JIRA, dashboard, and the SRE deploy diff. I'll run a short sync Friday 10:00 PT to close outstanding items. :white_check_mark:

tara: Noted. I'll put the invoice drafts in /ops-cs/ for review and schedule the outreach after legal signs off.

omar: Uploaded adjustments CSV to the ticket and attached a validation run (checksums + sample reconciliation rows).

billing-bot: Adjustment batch processed for 2 customers. Batch ID: AB-20240401-7. Logs: <https://billing.redwood/logs/AB-20240401-7>

jess: Closing loop — follow-up sync on Fri 10:00 PT. If owners hit blockers, ping in this thread. Thanks everyone.

michael: I'll have the RCA timeline and deploy diff in the doc by Wed AM.

tara: I'll have drafts ready by Thu noon, moving to legal review.

omar: Final reconciliation run scheduled for Tue 08:30 PT. Will post final deltas after run.

finance-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync on 2024-04-05T17:00:00Z.

jess: :thumbsup:
